production.note: US model years. First: BMW NA, 'The All-New 2020 BMW M340i and M340i xDrive Sedans', summer 2019 market launch. Still on sale: Edmunds' 2026 M340i page: "the M340i delivers ... (386 hp, 398 lb-ft) ... standard rear-wheel drive. All-wheel drive (xDrive) is optional" (edmunds-2026-m340i).

body.note: 2020 BMW 3 Series sedan. The xDrive car, sold as the M340i xDrive, is not part of this record.

aspiration.note: 'M TwinPower Turbo technology' with a 'single, Twin-scroll turbocharger'

fuel.note: Edmunds describes the 2026 car's '48-volt mild hybrid system' (edmunds-2026-m340i); a 48V mild hybrid counts as Gasoline.

drivetrain.note: Quote: "Drive type -- RWD AWD" (M340i, M340i xDrive).

powerHp.note: Quote: "Engine power hp 382 382" (M340i, M340i xDrive); release: "382 hp and peak torque of 369 lb-ft". Raised to 386 hp for the 2025 update: The Drive (Chris Tsui, 28 May 2024): "The straight-six M340i gets mild power and torque bumps, now making 386 horsepower and 398 lb-ft of torque, up 4 hp and 29 lb-ft" (thedrive-2025-3-series). 382 hp covers 2020 to 2024, most of the run so far.

weightLb.note: RWD sedan with the 8-speed automatic (the only transmission), 2020 model. Quote: "Curb weight lbs. 3,849 3,968" (M340i, M340i xDrive).
